notes.hook: Intriguing opening hook linking Madagascar directly to the Moon.
notes.clarity: Easy to follow main concept, though slightly dense with geology terms.
notes.payoff: Good reveal connecting Earth formations to lunar composition.
notes.visuals: Clear imagery overall, though beat 7 relies on a text-heavy diagram.
notes.loop: Smooth audio transition returning seamlessly to the first beat.
